summary: Adlai Nortye Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a corporate name change, redomiciliation from Cayman Islands to Singapore, a registered office address change, and transfer of share registrar to Boardroom. These changes were approved at an EGM on December 1, 2025, effective July 29, 2026. ADSs will trade under the new name on Nasdaq starting August 21, 2026, with CUSIP and symbol unchanged. No shareholder action is required. This is a routine corporate administrative event, not a special situation, with no deal terms or strategic implications.
